note: Union County, AR publishes no zoning district service. Its largest city, El Dorado (county seat), publishes its zoning only as a downloadable PDF/JPG map (2023), not a queryable service. The county assessor/GIS portals (unioncountyar.com, gis.equatorstudios.com/arkansas_union) show parcels only. The Arkansas GIS Office Planning_Cadastre, Location and Boundaries folders have no zoning layer.
